budget_items.quote: around but more than $40 million and we are going to contribute $150k to put towards opeb.

budget_items.topic: Capital Plan fuel tank project total
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Capital Plan item for two new fuel tanks was described as $220K; Mr. Rogers asked for a detailed explanation.
budget_items.quote: i am here to present some soid and detailed numbers for the $220k in

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Rodriquenz said the in-house plan first came to $110-$120K before the decision to engineer the project.

budget_items.topic: Engineering and related fuel tank costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Rodriquenz estimated the engineering work (Storm Water report, Storm Water Management Plan, Geotechnical Investigation, specifications, residual testing, shipping) at roughly $20k - $25k.
Mr. Rodriquenz estimated taking the tanks out of the ground at roughly $50K.

budget_items.topic: Total fuel tank project and removal cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jack said removing the tanks and replacing the hole would cost about $50K, with the total project roughly $220K including engineering.
budget_items.quote: the total project would be roughly $220k.

budget_items.topic: Cost per year of fuel tank project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Rodriquenz argued that $170K spread over a 50-year life comes to about $3400 per year.
budget_items.quote: you divide $170k by 50 and roughly get $3400 per year
